testcase.name: actual SQLite workflow: independent review produces one internal sandbox receipt, with no provider proof
package v3 adds C: professional approval cannot override the source signatory constraint
package v2 keeps A+B but invalidates v1 approval
recipient substitution is rejected at the final record boundary
three direct API boundaries: other company, service and tenant deny documents and commands
source expiry is evaluated using server time at execution
Terminal 3 mode fails closed even when business checks and snapshot approval pass
retry after a lost response returns the existing internal receipt, not a second effect
missing approval, preparer self-approval and agent self-approval denied
revoked reviewer cannot carry approval into a later execution
stored file bytes are verified before approval and release
unauthenticated writes, CSRF origins, malformed input and unknown fields rejected
reviewer invitations are single-use, email-bound and reject self-invites
compare-and-swap stops two approved snapshot writes from winning the same revision
anonymous fixture preview has no runtime evidence and only public synthetic PDFs
approval expiry and changed policy are blocked even when the source is current
